Class RendererService

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.particletext.render.RendererService
public final class RendererService extends Object
Owns saved renderer state and the shared particle scheduler.

Renderer creation and edits prepare replacement point clouds before persisting their records. Runtime state is published only after a successful atomic write. Read-only consumers receive immutable renderer snapshots.

All mutations and particle sends run on the server thread. Placeholder text is refreshed at the configured interval; renderer and packet cursors keep the shared budget bounded without permanently starving later renderers.
